page.overview:
What is Rabbit Stew?

Rabbit stew is a food item that can be eaten by the player.

To eat rabbit stew, press and hold while it is selected in the hotbar. Eating one restores hunger and 12 hunger saturation. This restores more hunger than any other food type in the game except cake, but has less saturation than a golden carrot, a cooked porkchop, or a steak.

Eating rabbit stew leaves the player with an empty bowl, similar to mushroom stew, suspicious stew, and beetroot soup.
